tools.name: civic_gene_variants
tools.description: All variants of one CIViC gene (by CIViC gene id), fully paginated — complete even for genes with hundreds of variants.
tools.returns: Returns total_count, pages_fetched, records (variant id, name, feature, aliases, variant types) sorted by variant id.

tools.name: civic_get_assertion
tools.description: One CIViC assertion by id: an expert-curated summary claim (AMP/ASCO/ CAP tier, ACMG codes, FDA companion test flags) aggregating evidence items for a molecular profile in a disease/therapy context. Returns found=false if absent.

tools.name: civic_get_evidence_item
tools.description: One CIViC evidence item by id: clinical significance of a molecular profile in a disease/therapy context (evidence level A–E, type, direction, significance, rating, disease, therapies, source). Returns found=false if absent.

tools.name: civic_get_molecular_profile
tools.description: One CIViC molecular profile by id (variant combination that evidence/ assertions attach to), incl. parsed name and component variant ids.

tools.name: civic_get_variant
tools.description: One CIViC variant by its CIViC variant id (details incl. aliases, variant types, feature/gene linkage). Returns found=false if absent.

tools.name: civic_search_assertions
tools.description: Search CIViC assertions by any combination of filters; fully paginated and count-verified, sorted by ascending assertion id. assertion_type PREDICTIVE|PROGNOSTIC|DIAGNOSTIC|PREDISPOSING|ONCOGENIC; assertion_direction SUPPORTS|DOES_NOT_SUPPORT; amp_level e.g. TIER_I_LEVEL_A; status ACCEPTED|SUBMITTED|REJECTED|ALL. Name/summary filters are substrings; id filters exact. No filters = full corpus walk.

tools.name: civic_search_diseases
tools.description: Search CIViC disease records by name substring (e.g. "melanoma").
tools.returns: Returns DOIDs + display names; fully paginated; sorted by id.

tools.name: civic_search_evidence
tools.description: Search CIViC evidence items by any combination of filters; fully paginated and count-verified, sorted by ascending evidence id. Enum filters take CIViC GraphQL enum values verbatim: evidence_level "A".."E"; evidence_type PREDICTIVE|PROGNOSTIC|DIAGNOSTIC| PREDISPOSING|ONCOGENIC|FUNCTIONAL; evidence_direction SUPPORTS| DOES_NOT_SUPPORT; significance e.g. SENSITIVITYRESPONSE|RESISTANCE; variant_origin e.g. SOMATIC|RARE_GERMLINE; status ACCEPTED|SUBMITTED| REJECTED|ALL. Name filters are substrings (disease_name, therapy_name, molecular_profile_name); id filters are exact CIViC ids. Warning: with no filters this walks the ENTIRE evidence corpus (10k+ items, ~100 paged requests) — provide at least one filter.

tools.name: civic_search_genes
tools.description: Find CIViC gene records by exact Entrez symbol (e.g. "BRAF").
tools.returns: Returns total_count, pages_fetched, records (CIViC gene id, name, entrez id, aliases, description, source ids) — use the gene id with civic_gene_variants.

tools.name: civic_search_molecular_profiles
tools.description: Search CIViC molecular profiles by name substring (e.g. "BRAF V600E"). Fully paginated; sorted by id.

tools.name: civic_search_therapies
tools.description: Search CIViC therapy records by name substring (e.g. "vemurafenib").
tools.returns: Returns NCIt ids + names; fully paginated; sorted by id.

tools.name: civic_search_variants
tools.description: Search CIViC variants by name substring (e.g. "V600"), optionally scoped to a CIViC gene id. Fully paginated; sorted by variant id.

tools.name: clingen_actionability
tools.description: ClinGen clinical actionability curations: for disorders associated with a gene, whether early intervention in pre-symptomatic carriers is actionable (intervention/outcome pairs with severity, likelihood, effectiveness, nature-of-intervention scores and the total score). The gene filter genuinely filters (the legacy tooluniverse method's gene filter was a silent no-op that always returned the entire table) and matches any member of multi-gene topics (e.g. BRCA1,BRCA2 HBOC).

gene.description: HGNC gene symbol (exact, case-insensitive). Omit for all topics.

tools.returns: Returns one block per context with total + records (doc_id, genes, disease, outcome, intervention, component scores, total_score, report stage/date), plus source.

tools.name: clingen_dosage_sensitivity
tools.description: ClinGen dosage sensitivity curations: haploinsufficiency and triplosensitivity assertions for genes (and optionally ISCA genomic regions such as recurrent CNV regions).

gene.description: HGNC gene symbol for exact, case-insensitive match, or an ISCA region ID (e.g. "ISCA-37390"). Omit for the full table.

include_regions.description: include ISCA region records alongside gene records (bulk listing is genes-only by default).

tools.returns: Returns total, records (symbol/id, record_type gene|region, haploinsufficiency + triplosensitivity assertions with numeric scores and labels, genomic location, report date), source.

tools.name: clingen_gene_validity
tools.description: ClinGen gene-disease validity curations (classification of how strong the evidence is that variation in a gene causes a disease: Definitive, Strong, Moderate, Limited, Disputed, Refuted, No Known Disease Relationship).

gene.description: HGNC gene symbol (exact, case-insensitive match — e.g. "BRCA2"). Omit to list ALL 3,600+ validity curations.

tools.returns: Returns total, records (gene_symbol, disease label + MONDO id, mode of inheritance, classification, SOP, expert panel, report date), source.

tools.name: clingen_variant_classifications
tools.description: ClinGen Evidence Repository (ERepo) expert-panel variant pathogenicity classifications (VCEP interpretations under ACMG criteria). Provide EXACTLY ONE of: gene: HGNC gene symbol (all classified variants in the gene — retrieval is complete, not capped at the first page). caid: ClinGen canonical allele ID (e.g. "CA114360"). hgvs: HGVS expression (e.g. "NM_000277.2:c.1222C>T").
tools.returns: Returns total, records (interpretation id, CAID, HGVS, gene, MONDO condition, classification e.g. Pathogenic/Likely Benign, ACMG criteria met, expert panel, evaluation date), query echo, source.

tools.name: open_targets_disease_drugs
tools.description: Known/investigational drugs for a disease (Open Targets Platform). Wraps ``Disease.drugAndClinicalCandidates`` (the upstream replacement for the removed ``knownDrugs`` field) — no introspection needed.

efo_id.description: disease ontology id as used by Open Targets (EFO/MONDO/etc.), e.g. "MONDO_0004992".

size.description: cap on returned rows (client-side slice — the upstream field is not paginated). Default 25.

tools.returns: Returns {id, name, drugAndClinicalCandidates:{count, rows:[{id, maxClinicalStage, drug:{id, name, drugType}}]}}, or {errors:[…]} on GraphQL error / unknown id.

tools.name: open_targets_disease_targets
tools.description: Top associated targets for a disease, ranked by Open Targets overall association score. Wraps ``Disease.associatedTargets(page:{size,index:0})`` — no introspection needed.
tools.returns: Returns {id, name, associatedTargets:{count, rows:[{score, target:{id, approvedSymbol}}]}}, or {errors:[…]} on GraphQL error / unknown id.

tools.name: open_targets_drug
tools.description: Drug details by ChEMBL id (Open Targets Platform). Wraps ``drug(chemblId:…)`` — no introspection needed.
tools.returns: Returns {id, name, drugType, maximumClinicalStage, mechanismsOfAction:{rows:[{mechanismOfAction, actionType, targets:[{id, approvedSymbol}]}]}}, or {errors:[…]} on GraphQL error / unknown id.

tools.name: open_targets_graphql
tools.description: Run an arbitrary GraphQL query against the Open Targets Platform API (https://api.platform.opentargets.org/api/v4/graphql): targets, diseases, drugs, target-disease association scores, evidence, tractability, safety, known drugs, etc. Example: query='query($id: String!){target(ensemblId: $id){approvedSymbol associatedDiseases{count}}}', variables={"id": "ENSG00000157764"}. Introspection queries work for schema discovery. Common top-level fields (live-introspected; saves a schema round-trip — note ``knownDrugs`` was renamed to ``drugAndClinicalCandidates`` upstream): * Disease: id, name, description, synonyms, therapeuticAreas, ancestors, descendants, parents, children, phenotypes, associatedTargets, drugAndClinicalCandidates, evidences, otarProjects, similarEntities * Target: id, approvedSymbol, approvedName, biotype, functionDescriptions, genomicLocation, tractability, safetyLiabilities, geneticConstraint, pathways, geneOntology, expressions, interactions, associatedDiseases, drugAndClinicalCandidates, prioritisation, pharmacogenomics * Drug: id, name, drugType, description, synonyms, tradeNames, maximumClinicalStage, mechanismsOfAction, indications, drugWarnings, adverseEvents, pharmacogenomics, crossReferences
tools.returns: Returns {data, attempts} plus an "errors" list when the server reports GraphQL errors. Transient "Internal server error" responses (a known platform quirk on valid queries) are retried up to 3 attempts before being surfaced.
